name: Stage 23: Hälleforsnäs to Svalboviken
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 23, Hälleforsnäs to Svalboviken.
utilities: Official area: Eskilstunas kommun, Flens kommun, Hälleforsnäs, Katrineholms kommun.
Hälleforsnäs/Bruket is the service side: rail/bus via station and 22:1, grocery, restaurants/cafes, lodging and parking at Edströmsvallen or Turistbyrån/Bruket.
There is no parking at the exact stage-23 start; use Edströmsvallen or Turistbyrån/Bruket and walk in.

Mögsjön is the key mid-stage overnight/rest node with shelter, dry toilet, picnic/rest context, fireplace/grill context and official suitable tent spots. Svalboviken is a rural road endpoint with parking context from stage 24, but no shop, toilet, tap or dependable walk-up transit.
waterSources: Fyrsjön well is the only official stage water point, about 1.5 km after the start. It may need priming and Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee tested potable quality, so treat/filter and carry backup.
Mögsjön, Fyrsjön, Båven/Svalboviken-area lakes and other lakes are natural surface water only.
If continuing onto stage 24, the Svalboviken south source is listed with uncertain quality; do not assume it as reliable.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official distance is 12 km. OSM relation 3925449 is the correct Stage 23 relation and computes around 11.7 km, but its distance tag still says 13 km; older/third-party material may also show 13 km. AllTrails/Naturkartan cross-checks are consistent with roughly 11.7-12.0 km and moderate, rolling terrain.

Draw Stage 23 as the mainline Hälleforsnäs/Bruksdammen junction to Svalboviken segment, including the final road walk northwest to the stage-24 start. Do not include 22:1, 23:1, 23:2, 24 or 24:3 unless selected as access/branch routes.

Official page showed no current fault reports during the 2026-04-28 research pass. A March 2024 comment reported clear-cuts, fallen trees and unclear marking around Ramsbäck-Mögsjön, while later 2024 and June 2025 comments were positive and described the stage as well maintained with good boardwalks.

After Mögsjön the route has around 3 km of moss/myr/boardwalk terrain toward the Hälleforsnäs-Svalboviken road. Expect slippery boardwalks, wet ground and slower footing after rain or frost even when the stage is passable.

The route follows or edges Långmossen. Where the route enters the Långmossen nature reserve, its rules prohibit camping, fires, motor vehicles, unleashed dogs, tree/dead-wood damage and most plant picking; outside the reserve, follow posted signs and allemansrätten.
Båven is Natura 2000 with bird-protection areas and extended shoreline protections in places. Obey signed seasonal access bans and avoid shore/island detours that are not clearly open.
Mögsjön shelter is free/shared/first-come, not bookable, and firewood is not supplied. Use the established fireplace only when current fire-ban status allows it.

Skogsstyrelsen forestry notices from 2023 and 2025 lie close to or cross the route near Fyrsjön/Fågelhäll and Svalboviken; keep current markings/GPX visible through clear-cut areas. Camping near Svalboviken can be awkward because of clear-cuts, road noise and sparse services.

facilities.name: Hälleforsnäs stage-23 start
facilities.description: Official stage-23 start. No parking at the exact start; access via 22:1/Bruksslingan or nearby parking.

facilities.name: Hälleforsnäs station access
facilities.description: Strong public-transport access via station and connector 22:1; Mälartåg/Sörmlandstrafiken access and bus 415 context were verified, but live departures and replacement-bus positions must be checked.

facilities.name: Hälleforsnäs station bus stop
facilities.description: OSM-mapped station bus stop with shelter/bench/bin/lit/tactile context and bus 415 toward Flen. Use with live Sörmlandstrafiken checks.

facilities.name: Edströmsvallen parking/access
facilities.description: Use Edströmsvallen or Turistbyrån/Bruket for parking; exact stage start has no parking. Coordinate is approximate to the public map area rather than a guaranteed parking-bay centroid.

facilities.name: Bruket / Hälleforsnäs services
facilities.description: Service cluster with tourist info, restaurants/cafes/bakery and nearby grocery. Opening hours vary.

facilities.name: Coop Hälleforsnäs
facilities.description: Grocery/resupply in Hälleforsnäs before starting. Check current opening hours.

facilities.name: Bäckstugan B&B
facilities.description: Hiker-oriented lodging near Sörmlandsleden in Hälleforsnäs; coordinate approximate and availability must be checked.

facilities.name: Bruksdammen nearby access facilities
facilities.description: Nearby Bruksslingan facility cluster has shelter, grill and accessible toilet; toilet is closed in winter. Useful near the Hälleforsnäs access, not mid-stage.

facilities.name: Fyrsjön well
facilities.description: Only official stage water point, about 1.5 km from Hälleforsnäs. May need priming with lake water and has no tested-potable guarantee; treat/filter and carry backup.

facilities.name: Fågelhäll torp ruin/rest spot
facilities.description: Approximate rest/heritage marker for the torp ruin noted by official text after roughly one hour. Hiker reports use it as a lunch/rest point; exact facility coordinate remains approximate.

facilities.name: Långmossen reserve/mire caution
facilities.description: Where the route enters or edges Långmossen reserve, rules prohibit camping, fires, motor vehicles, unleashed dogs, tree/dead-wood damage and most plant picking. Stay on durable surfaces/boardwalks.

facilities.name: Mögsjön shelter
facilities.description: Official shelter after about 6.5 km. Shared first-come shelter, not bookable; OSM maps the shelter cluster close by and recent comments describe the area as well maintained.

facilities.name: Mögsjön dry toilet
facilities.description: Dry toilet at the shelter/rest area, mapped beside the shelter cluster.

facilities.name: Mögsjön picnic/rest table
facilities.description: Picnic/rest table mapped at the Mögsjön shelter cluster; useful as the main mid-stage rest stop.

facilities.name: Mögsjön tent/swim/lake-water context
facilities.description: Official suitable tent spots near the shelter; reports say flatter tenting may be easier slightly south/closer to the lake than directly by the shelter rock. Lake water only, and swimming access is informal/rough.

facilities.name: Mögsjön fire/firewood caveat
facilities.description: Shelter fire/cooking context. Sörmlandsleden says shelters have grill/fireplace but does not supply firewood; check fire bans and only use established places.

facilities.name: Mögsjön-Svalboviken myr/boardwalk caution
facilities.description: Roughly 3 km of moss/myr and boardwalk terrain after Mögsjön. Recent reports are positive, but older comments mention slippery boardwalks and fallen trees; expect wet-weather slickness.

facilities.name: Stage 23 forestry/clear-cut caution
facilities.description: Forestry notices from 2023/2025 lie close to the route near Fyrsjön/Fågelhäll and Svalboviken. Clear-cuts can make markings harder to follow; keep GPX/current signs visible.

facilities.name: Båven protection/fishing caveat
facilities.description: Lake Båven has Natura 2000, bird-protection and shoreline-protection contexts. Fishing generally requires checking permits, and Visit Flen notes Båven fishing is from islands or boat only.

facilities.name: Svalboviken parking/access
facilities.description: Stage-23 end/stage-24 start with good parking per official stage 24. Rural endpoint with weak transit and no robust services.

facilities.name: Svalboviken weak-transit caveat
facilities.description: No convincing regular stop was verified at the endpoint. Nearest mapped rural bus context is several kilometres away and complementary traffic may require advance booking; plan car/bike shuttle or live-check Sörmlandstrafiken.

facilities.name: Knektbacken rural bus context
facilities.description: Nearest mapped rural bus context found during research, roughly 3 km by road from Svalboviken; sparse/route-dependent and not a dependable endpoint service without live verification.
